_meta.source: ReliefWeb reports; publisher RSS feeds; GDELT DOC 2.0
_meta.notes: Headlines that name El Niño, La Niña or ENSO, from the humanitarian reports API, the publisher feeds the commodity wire reads, outlets in the places El Niño hits, and one GDELT query. Third-party CLAIMS with links, never measured data; nothing scores off this file. Country tags are keyword matches; outlet_iso3 is a national outlet's home country, not a tag. Last-good items are kept for 21 days so a throttled or failed run does not blank the wire.
